endpoint_contracts.GET /api/vision/legacy-presets: Returns advisory legacy perception presets derived from audit reports.
endpoint_contracts.GET /api/vision/real-camera/status: Reports real camera evidence readiness without mock fallback.
endpoint_contracts.POST /api/vision/real-camera/capture-evi: Attempts evidence metadata capture only; no physical command path.
endpoint_contracts.GET /api/vision/real-camera/latest: Returns latest real camera evidence metadata.

mock_fallback_policy: Real camera evidence endpoint reports not_available when no real camera is configured; it does not convert mock frames into real camera evidence.
